visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle shot of a black frying pan on an induction cooktop. Bright green asparagus stalks are submerged in boiling, bubbling water. The water is clear, and steam rises from the surface. (2) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a black T-shirt and a brown leather strap across his chest, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. He looks directly at the camera, talking with animated facial expressions, including squints and smiles. (3) The scene shifts to a supermarket aisle. The man stands in front of refrigerated shelves stocked with various packaged foods. He holds a green plastic shopping basket. Bright fluorescent lights illuminate the white tiled floor and colorful packaging. (4) Close-up shots follow of ingredients: fresh sea fish, a container of alfalfa sprouts, and a large tray of raw shrimp. The man's hand is seen placing these into his basket. (5) Back in a modern kitchen with white cabinets and stainless steel appliances, the man prepares food. He boils the shrimp in a small white pot and then transfers them along with the asparagus into a stainless steel bowl filled with ice water. (6) The man creates a sauce in a small white bowl, adding yogurt and mustard using a silver spoon. He then assembles a seaweed wrap on a wooden table, layering alfalfa sprouts, asparagus, and smoked salmon, then drizzling the white sauce over it. (7) The man is shown performing a series of exercises in the living area. He does push-ups, burpees, and kettlebell swings. He wears a grey T-shirt and black shorts. The room is well-lit with a large refrigerator in the background.

The male speaker continues his narration, his pitch rising as he lists food items. The background music remains consistent in volume and tempo.
